## TemplateEngine.MAX\_PAID\_MEDIA\_ITEMS property

Maximum items in a single `<g-paid-media>` block.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static MAX_PAID_MEDIA_ITEMS: number;
```

## Remarks

Matches the Bot API `sendPaidMedia` `media` limit of 10 items (source: `https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendpaidmedia`<!-- -->). Blocks need 1–10 `<g-media>` items of type `photo`<!-- -->/`video`<!-- -->.
